searchText: Can someone help me pull up some stats? I'd like to see statistics on all tornado cash transactions post merge, and how long they took to be included in a block when paying the appropriate gas fee. I'm guessing they were all included in the next block. what is the smaller pruned full node for both the execution client and the consensus client ? I know that Nethermind has a pruning feature, that can get fairly small (hundreds of GB), but it still grows over time because I don't believe they support block header/body/receipt pruning yet. mine are 717GB (decimal) pretty big geth 603GB lighthouse 115GB hmm there's some rounding going on can geth get even smaller by pruning more stuff? or maybe erigon like 300GB would be good i have 1TB ssd and i would like to run it locally both nodes together (i mean ofc) I think you can safely delete ancient chain in geth? yes? that's 370GB ok. that's better or is geth going to crash <:think:815760797938221056> can someone confirm we need more culture of running full nodes at home in ethereum land in erigon I think you can set it up so that only recent state and some recent blocks are stored. so maybe even 100GB? This requires the protocol receive some changes that make this more reasonable/possible than it is now. culture isn't changing. current cost to run nodes is irrelevant. people that need nodes can run them, people that don't - won't even if it's super light. what ethereum needs right now are withdrawals for example I'm in steth because I thought nothing going to happen regarding censorship that soon and liquidity is a massive advantage I agree, we should go in that direction. Ideally wallets should incorporate a full node or at least a light node. I think we should prioritize things moving us in that direction, such as verkle trees, instead of danksharding. It'll crash por que no los dos danksharding is very important for enabling L2s people *will* run nodes if you trick them into doing it and it's not harmful, if the costs of altruism are low and altruism is the default then people will just do the right thing When are the EIPs for shanghai decided? I think there is a #shanghai-planning channel planned when ACD calls are resumed on Oct 27. And until then, people are taking a break. Some CFI EIPs are here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/master/network-upgrades/mainnet-upgrades/shanghai.md or you can search by tag on eth magicians: https://ethereum-magicians.org/tag/shanghai-candidate
